Notes: The existing regional ṭhēhunā knee/elbow family is registered in extensions_ia.csv e82 and includes Chitwan ṭhehun knee. Independently, full Platts p.366 gives ṭhewnā/ṭheʼonā/ṭheʼunā knee and nasalized variants. The selected Danuwar/Tharu knee responses are grouped provisionally in this regional family, preserving medial h, vowels, nasalization and final ī/u/a. This is family membership only: it does not establish the starred head as an ancient reconstruction or adopt Platts’s aṣṭhīvan derivation. Earlier elbow-semantic concerns remain separate; these responses mean knee. Regional IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: tʰeuna. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.
